title: Structured Output Judge
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Judge whether each of six model replies is valid JSON in a required format, and name the defect in each invalid one.

learningObjectives: The learner will judge whether each of 6 model replies is valid JSON that matches a given required format, naming the defect in each invalid reply, with at least 5 of 6 judged correctly.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: Reply 4 contains exactly the JSON of reply 1. Explain why a program rejects one and accepts the other.
commonMisconceptions: A reply that looks right is valid.
A reply containing valid JSON inside explanatory text is valid.
An empty array is a missing field.
